audit.why: Nilah's passive shares healing/shielding to allies and her ult heals her — Grievous Wounds timing directly changes whether chip poke matters in extended trades.
audit.corrected: See edits: report[8] itemization already mentions anti-heal but breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull now cite real numbers and the sustain interaction is named in dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: Dodges ALL attacks while it shimmers — never auto into the veil; spells still land. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Joy Unending shares healing to her support, so anti-heal timing decides extended trades as much as landing Q — buy it before you commit to a long fight.

edits.before: - Nilah Jubilant Veil: matchup-defining — Dodges ALL attacks while it shimmers — never auto into the veil; spells still land. Check it before every step-up. - E Spell Shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Jubilant Veil (W) is a 26-22s dodge window — never auto into the shimmer, but spells still land through it. - Formless Blade (Q) is only 4s, so her poke tempo resets fast between trades. - Spell Shield refreshes 24-18s; save it for Slipstream (E), not chip.

notes: Fixed misgendering throughout (Nilah is she/her) and folded in the anti-heal missingInteraction (Joy Unending/Apotheosis sustain) into dosFull[0].d. breakdown.cooldowns now carries real numbers (Jubilant Veil 26-22s, Formless Blade 4s, Spell Shield 24-18s). suspectNames also flagged 'Spell Shielding' in wants.you[1] as a possible typo for 'spell shield' but that reading looks like normal gerund usage, not a fabricated name, so left alone.
